mapper.sql: PUSH_SEQ, MEM_ID, ENDPOINT, ENDPOINT_HASH, P256DH, AUTH, USER_AGENT, FAIL_CNT, LAST_ERR, DATE_FORMAT(LAST_SENT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS LAST_SENT_DT, DATE_FORMAT(INS_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS INS_DT, DATE_FORMAT(UDT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS UDT_DT, STATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PUSH_SUB_TB ( MEM_ID, ENDPOINT, ENDPOINT_HASH, P256DH, AUTH, USER_AGENT, STATE ) VALUES ( #{memId}, #{endpoint}, #{endpointHash}, #{p256dh}, #{auth}, #{userAgent}, 'I' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE MEM_ID = #{memId}, ENDPOINT = #{endpoint}, P256DH = #{p256dh}, AUTH = #{auth}, USER_AGENT = #{userAgent}, FAIL_CNT = 0, LAST_ERR = NULL, UDT_DT = NOW(), STATE = 'I'
mapper.update: UPDATE PUSH_SUB_TB SET STATE = 'D', LAST_ERR = #{lastErr}, UDT_DT = NOW() WHERE ENDPOINT_HASH = #{endpointHash}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM PUSH_SUB_TB WHERE MEM_ID = #{memId} AND STATE = 'I' ORDER BY PUSH_SEQ
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PUSH_SUB_TB WHERE MEM_ID = #{memId} AND STATE = 'I'
mapper.update: UPDATE PUSH_SUB_TB SET FAIL_CNT = 0, LAST_ERR = NULL, LAST_SENT_DT = NOW() WHERE PUSH_SEQ = #{pushSeq}
UPDATE PUSH_SUB_TB SET FAIL_CNT = FAIL_CNT + 1, LAST_ERR = #{lastErr}, UDT_DT = NOW(), STATE = IF(FAIL_CNT + 1 >= 10, 'D', STATE) WHERE PUSH_SEQ = #{pushSeq}
